doc: Kernel B (machine qa-b, project beta) registers on a local hub. From node A: `store read` of B's notes.md, `store put` into B's docs/ (allowed), the same put with a stale base hash (conflict, current hash returned), a put to B's root-owned notes.md (refused, unchanged), `store ls`, and a read of a path with `..` (refused).

breaks.detail: the conflict reply does not carry the file's current hash for a re-read

put_stale: Error: docs/from-a.md: conflict — the file changed since you read it; read it again and redo the edit
put_page: Error: notes.md: .arbos/notes.md (the project page), docs/project-context.md, and archived.md are owned by the main chat (root); keep your own checklist with the plan tool and propose the change with `say to=root`
read_dotdot: Error: "arbos://qa-b/beta/../../etc/passwd": a store path does not climb out with ..
read_unknown_machine: Error: arbos://nobody/beta/notes.md: hub: no machine named "nobody" is registered (known: qa-b)
